CheckTitle: Ensure Privileged Access is Certified Periodically
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management (Advanced Controls)
Description: Review users' roles and data access periodically: monthly for IT administrators and quarterly for everyone else.
Risk: Users accumulate roles as their responsibilities change, leaving unintended abilities in place.
AuditProcedure: Tools > Scheduled Processes: run and review the User and Role Access Audit Report and User Role Membership Report.
Or run Access Certification campaigns in Risk Management.

Steps: Remove roles that are no longer justified, or keep them and monitor the transactions they allow.
Review the affected transactions in Tools > Reports and Analytics, or monitor them continuously with Risk Management Transaction Controls.

DefaultValue: No periodic review is enforced by default.
